name: wc3-chrome
notes: The repository holds the extension (manifest, background service worker, accessibility-tree, page-bridge and visual-indicator content scripts) and PoC scripts; the relay that connects to it lives in the webclaw3 repository. It needs Chrome 100+ and Node.js 22+ for the relay. MIT license.
summary: A Chrome MV3 extension that executes webclaw3 browser operations: it takes op commands from a local relay over WebSocket and drives real Chrome through chrome.* APIs, with aria-tree element references.
